FFmpeg in Plajah
================

Plajah Crossover runs FFmpeg as a separate program (ffmpeg.exe and ffprobe.exe). FFmpeg is not part of
Plajah and is not written by Plajah. It is a project of the FFmpeg developers: https://ffmpeg.org

This build is a GPL build from BtbN/FFmpeg-Builds. It includes libx264, libx265 and other libraries, and as
a whole is licensed under the GNU General Public License, version 3 or later. The full licence is in
FFMPEG-LICENSE.txt, next to this file, and at https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-3.0.html

This program comes with NO WARRANTY, to the extent permitted by law.

You may copy, change and share FFmpeg under the terms of that licence. Those terms cover FFmpeg only, and
do not extend to the rest of Plajah, which is a separate work that starts FFmpeg as another program.


Source code
-----------

This copy is FFmpeg n8.1.3-29-gad3b795b72, from the BtbN/FFmpeg-Builds release autobuild-2026-11-01-12-49
(ffmpeg-n8.1.3-29-gad3b795b72-win64-gpl-8.1.zip). "ffmpeg -version" prints the version, and Crossover shows
it under "About the engine".

  FFmpeg source:  https://github.com/FFmpeg/FFmpeg  (commit ad3b795b72388fbb2b216e1e6fd38fba994e1df0)
  Build scripts, and the libraries they compile in:  https://github.com/BtbN/FFmpeg-Builds
    (commit 5ece62897c650b863c1ddda7b6964845344aef2d)

The complete source for this copy, with every library compiled in, is free to download from Plajah (1.07 GB):
https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/gen-lang-client-0665118474.firebasestorage.app/o/open-source%2Fffmpeg%2Fn8.1.3-29-gad3b795b72%2Fplajah-ffmpeg-source-n8.1.3-29-gad3b795b72.tar.xz?alt=media&token=40b7bfdb-4f14-4d3a-b9e5-85d3cfaaf6e2
SHA-256: 048e600499b4cfe288aa02532057418ba93ebd90ffa6a04a212e02c34dcc1cd5

The same copy of the program can be downloaded from Plajah at:
https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/gen-lang-client-0665118474.firebasestorage.app/o/open-source%2Fffmpeg%2Fn8.1.3-29-gad3b795b72%2Fffmpeg-n8.1.3-29-gad3b795b72-win64-gpl-8.1.zip?alt=media&token=40b7bfdb-4f14-4d3a-b9e5-85d3cfaaf6e2

Questions: legal@plajah.com


Pro codec pack
--------------

Where a device has no FFmpeg program, Crossover can download FFmpeg compiled to WebAssembly, from
https://github.com/ffmpegwasm/ffmpeg.wasm. It is under the GNU General Public License too, and is fetched
directly by your device from https://cdn.jsdelivr.net


Patents
-------

Some formats, including H.264, HEVC and Dolby audio, may be covered by patents in some countries. This
licence does not grant any patent rights in those formats.
